name: Cursor Tooltip
description: Tactile cursor-following tooltip with continuous exponential lerp tracking, boundary viewport collision clamping, multi-variant tokens, and zero Framer Motion dependencies.

props.name: content
props.label: Tooltip Content
props.description: Text or badge label displayed inside the trailing tooltip.

props.name: springDamping
props.label: Spring Damping
props.description: Exponential smoothing factor for trailing cursor physics (higher = snappy, lower = trailing glide).

props.name: offsetX
props.label: Offset X (px)
props.description: Horizontal distance from cursor to tooltip origin in pixels.

props.name: offsetY
props.label: Offset Y (px)
props.description: Vertical distance from cursor to tooltip origin in pixels.

props.name: variant
props.label: Badge Variant
props.description: Visual token styling of the floating tooltip badge.

props.name: direction
props.label: Direction
props.description: Directional orientation and quadrant placement relative to cursor pointer.

props.name: collisionPadding
props.label: Collision Padding (px)
props.description: Safe margin in pixels between tooltip and viewport edges to prevent clipping.

wordpress.description: WordPress Gutenberg block metadata with client-side viewScript for Cursor Tooltip.
wordpress.code:
{
  "$schema": "https://schemas.wp.org/trunk/block.json",
  "apiVersion": 3,
  "name": "exhuma/cursor-tooltip",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "title": "Cursor Tooltip",
  "category": "widgets",
  "description": "Tactile cursor-following tooltip with continuous exponential lerp tracking and boundary collision clamping.",
  "supports": {
    "html": false,
    "anchor": true
  },
  "attributes": {
    "content": { "type": "string", "default": "Explore Showcase" },
    "springDamping": { "type": "number", "default": 20 },
    "direction": { "type": "string", "default": "bottom-right" },
    "offsetX": { "type": "number", "default": 16 },
    "offsetY": { "type": "number", "default": 16 },
    "variant": { "type": "string", "default": "frosted" },
    "collisionPadding": { "type": "number", "default": 12 }
  },
  "viewScript": "file:./view.js",
  "render": "file:./render.php"
}
